title: Veda Parichayam- 2
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt: RIGVEDA SAMHITHANature and Importance:The Rigveda is the oldest compilation of human wisdom. This Samhita (Collection) is unique in its nature. In fact, it is not a book, but a compilation composed of several books which can be individually distinguished from each other. The present form of this Samhita clearly indicates that the collection is not a single word, but consists of older and later elements.
